errors.text: The proposed 22–41 GPa and 400–600°C treatment does not reconstruct the effective 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT window.
The central B2-to-hcp transformation is inferred from an fcc-to-hcp transition in CoCrFeMnNi; this evidence does not establish that ordered NiAl-rich B2 lamellae undergo an analogous transition.
The hypothesis retains or disorders the lamellar architecture rather than producing the target hierarchical patterned microstructure with coherent FCC/B2 interfaces.
The proposed mechanism omits coherent-interface-mediated dislocation transfer, convergence of phase-specific GND densities, and activation of multiple deformation modes.

The baseline is compositionally and microstructurally mismatched: it substitutes as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 for homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi and describes the cited as-cast material as poorly ductile despite the cited source reporting high ductility and strain hardening.
The statement that high stacking-fault energy promotes the proposed transformation conflicts with the cited low-stacking-fault-energy rationale for fcc-to-hcp transformation.
